_comment: Example OIV fund config. NOT all optional: .sharesChains is REQUIRED by DeployOiv.deploy and by _buildSharesChains, which additionally requires an .oiv.assetOverrides entry for EVERY declared shares chain. A timelock block, if present, must carry ALL THREE of minDelay, proposers and cancellers: minDelay must be non-zero and within 12h-30d (zero is the no-timelock sentinel and is refused), while proposers and cancellers each require the KEY though an explicit [] is accepted for either. To deploy without a timelock, omit the whole block. Two earlier versions of this comment were wrong - the first claimed all of this was optional, the second said proposers was required "even at minDelay 0" and never mentioned cancellers. Parsed by script/base/OivConfigReader.sol and pinned by test/OivConfigReader.t.sol.
